quasium.progression.introduction.title: Welcome to Quasium!
quasium.progression.introduction.page1: Welcome to the world of Quasium! This mod is about tobacco, hookahs, and the mysterious 'kaif'. But before you can smoke your first hookah, there's a long journey: grow, process and blend tobacco, prepare charcoal... Entries in this book unlock gradually — each hint leads to the next step.
quasium.progression.introduction.page2: First, get some tobacco seeds. Four wild varieties live in different biomes: Dikar in plains and forests, Peschanik in deserts, Bolotnik in swamps, Ledyanoy in snow and mountains. Dikar seeds sometimes drop from grass, and a farmer villager sells Dikar and Peschanik at 4 seeds for 2 emeralds. Book + seeds = this progression book.
quasium.progression.introduction.page3: Don't try to assemble a hookah right away — it's a complex mechanism. Start simple: seeds → leaves → fermentation → tobacco. Each new entry unlocks when you reach the corresponding stage. Follow the hints!
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.title: Tobacco Crops
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.hint: Wild tobacco varieties grow somewhere out there... Find their seeds and plant them.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page1: Seeds come from wild bushes, from a farmer villager, or from grass. Plant them on farmland — they grow like regular crops. Pour a water bucket on a bush to speed up growth. Shear a mature bush to get leaves, sometimes along with a seed.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page2: The four varieties differ in three star-rated stats: strength, yield and quality. Peschanik is the strongest (5) but coarse. Bolotnik gives the most leaves. Ledyanoy is weak but pure. Dikar is the middle ground. Stars carry over into leaves and shape the final blend.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page3: Place a pole between two bushes — it starts cross-breeding and yields a hybrid seed in 1–2 minutes. A wooden pole succeeds 70% of the time, reinforced 85%, golden 95%, diamond always. The pricier the pole, the higher the mutation chance.
quasium.progression.fermentation.title: Fermentation
quasium.progression.fermentation.hint: Raw leaves aren't ready yet... Maybe some kind of barrel could process them?
quasium.progression.fermentation.page1: Fermentation barrel: 8 planks + 1 iron ingot. Load raw leaves (up to 16) and hit the barrel with a netherite hammer to start. Fermentation takes 60 seconds.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page2: Sugar speeds it up: each portion cuts 10 seconds but adds a 15% risk of spoiling the batch. The barrel won't take more than three portions. Spoiled leaves are useless — decide whether the rush is worth it.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page3: Fermented leaves are the raw material for self-mixed tobacco in the soaking bowl. And to make the blend smooth you'll need molasses... Hint: look into the drying shelf — even rotten flesh can become useful.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.title: Drying Shelf
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.hint: Something needs to be dried... Even rotten flesh might gain value through proper drying.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.page1: The drying shelf mounts on a wall. Craft: 6 planks and 2 sticks. Put a single item inside — the shelf dries it on its own. Rotten flesh turns into tallow in 20 seconds, an undried quasium block becomes a quasium block in 30 seconds.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.page2: Tallow feeds the molasses chain: tallow → glycerin → molasses. Raw meat and fish turn into jerky. Tobacco leaves can be dried too: up to 100% they are simply dry, past 140% they become overdried — those yield a stronger blend.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.title: Molasses Chain
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.hint: Tallow can be processed further... Into glycerin, then molasses — key ingredient for tobacco.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page1: Molasses production chain: 1) Rotten flesh → drying shelf → Tallow. 2) Ghast tear + potion → Bottled Ghast Acid (shapeless craft). 3) Tallow + Bottled Ghast Acid → Glycerin (brewing stand). 4) Glycerin + Honey + Sugar → Molasses (shapeless craft).
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page2: Glycerin is brewed in a brewing stand: ghast acid on top, tallow in the bottles below. The acid needs a ghast tear and any potion. Molasses needs a honey bottle from a bee nest. Molasses stores mass (5 units) — used in the soaking bowl.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page3: Molasses affects self-mixed strength: more molasses = lower strength = less smoke damage. 0 ml = max strength, 5 ml = no strength. Now you can create self-mixed tobacco in the soaking bowl.
quasium.progression.charcoal.title: Hookah Charcoal
quasium.progression.charcoal.hint: Regular charcoal won't work... Need special hookah coals — different sizes.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page1: Raw briquette: 2 charcoal/coal + 1 clay = 3 briquettes (shapeless). Then cut with stonecutter: 22mm (3 pcs, low heat), 25mm (2 pcs, medium), 27mm (1 pc, strong).
quasium.progression.charcoal.page2: Three sizes: 22mm — heat 1.0, 3600 ticks (3 min), volume 3. 25mm — heat 1.5, 6000 ticks (5 min), volume 4. 27mm — heat 2.0, 9600 ticks (8 min), volume 6. Bigger = hotter and longer.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page3: Charcoal needs to be heated in the hookah heater before use. After heating, load into the calloud — heat management device. Next step: craft a calloud.
quasium.progression.calloud.title: Calloud
quasium.progression.calloud.hint: How to manage charcoal heat? Need a calloud — temperature control device.
quasium.progression.calloud.page1: Calloud: iron + copper (craft). 4 base slots + 4 stacked slots. Stacked coal = 50% heat of base. Total volume = max 12.
quasium.progression.calloud.page2: Loading examples: 4×22mm = volume 12, 3×25mm = 12, 2×27mm = 12. Stacked coals add extra heat but weaker. Overheat: if heat > threshold × 1.8, tobacco burns faster!
quasium.progression.calloud.page3: Heat thresholds: regular tobacco = 1.0, self-mixed on tobacco = 1.5, on makhorka = 2.0. Puff efficiency is full at heat ratio ≥ 0.6 and drops below that. The caulloud itself needs no heating — only coals go into the heater, and they are moved into the caulloud already hot.
quasium.progression.heater.title: Hookah Heater
quasium.progression.heater.hint: How to heat charcoal and calloud? Need a special stove...
quasium.progression.heater.page1: Heater: bricks + copper + iron (craft). 15 slots for charcoal plus a separate fuel slot for plain charcoal. One unit of fuel burns for 80 seconds. Heating runs three times faster than the coal burns down.
quasium.progression.heater.page2: Without fuel the coals cool down, but twice as slowly as they heated — a short break is harmless. Heated coals show their percentage in the tooltip. Move finished coals into the caulloud; the caulloud itself doesn't need heating.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.title: Hookah Bowl
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.hint: Need a bowl to pack tobacco... How does it work?
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page1: Hookah bowl: 20 slots for packing. Tear off 1g (right-click in air) and place in bowl slots. Bowl supports up to 15 tobacco slots — if more, burn rate ×1.5!
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page2: Compatibility: all regular tobaccos are compatible. All self-mixed with same base are compatible. Regular + self-mixed = INCOMPATIBLE → kaif subtracted, nausea! When bowl is in hookah (heated), tobacco is locked.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page3: Burned tobacco can be removed from the bowl. Pack the bowl, place in hookah, and... time to smoke!
quasium.progression.regular_tobacco.hint: Fermented leaves can become flavored tobacco. After that, the interesting part begins: build your own blend.
quasium.progression.regular_tobacco.page: Ready-made packs weigh 30 g and are sold by a journeyman cleric villager. Right-click in the air to pinch off a 1 g portion — that's what goes into the bowl. The range covers mint, four citruses, berry and a dozen more flavors.

You can blend flavors right in the hookah bowl: put portions of different tobaccos into separate slots and the smoke picks up all their effects. Percentages are computed automatically from the number of filled slots. One rule: regular tobacco and self-mixed don't go together.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.title: Soaking Bowl
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.hint: Fermented leaves + essence + molasses = self-mixed tobacco. This is where flavor alchemy begins.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page1: Craft the soaking bowl from 4 bricks and clay. Add fermented leaves, an essence bottle in 5 ml portions and, if needed, molasses. Stir it with a stick.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page2: The bowl uses essence, not a potion. Each essence carries a specific flavor. You can combine flavors, but watch the liquid balance: too dry or too wet and the mix will fail.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page3: When processing finishes, the bowl gives a 30 g pack of self-mixed tobacco. Leaf type and liquid amount affect strength; essence transfers its flavor effects. Too many different essences can make the mixture toxic.
quasium.progression.hookah.title: Hookah
quasium.progression.hookah.hint: Need to assemble a hookah... Calloud, bowl, pipe.
quasium.progression.hookah.page1: The hookah is the heart of the mod. Place it on the ground. Slot 0: calloud (with heated coals). Slot 1: bowl with tobacco. Attach pipe (Shift+RMB) — puffing starts!
quasium.progression.hookah.page2: The extra slots accept a diffuser, cooler and ice chamber. The diffuser raises puff efficiency by 10% and halves coal consumption; the cooler lowers the active heat threshold by 20%; the ice chamber gives a 25% chance to create freezing smoke.
quasium.progression.hookah.page3: Tune the hookah to your smoking style: correct heat matters more than simply adding coals. Puff efficiency depends on heat ratio and tobacco stage. Excessive heat burns tobacco faster, while overloading the bowl increases its burn rate.
quasium.progression.hookah.page4: The hookah works the same way in the world and in its backpack version. The portable variant uses the same coals, bowl, upgrades and heat thresholds; only controls and state storage are different.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.mint: Speed — mint tobacco gives a speed effect. Higher percentage = stronger and longer. Above 70% effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.lemon: Strength — lemon tobacco gives a strength effect.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.lime: Strength — lime tobacco gives a strength effect.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.orange: Strength — orange tobacco gives a strength effect.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.grapef: Strength — grapefruit tobacco gives a strength effect.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.berry: Jump Boost — berry tobacco gives a jump boost effect. Higher percentage = stronger and longer. Above 70% effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.self_mixed: Self-mixed (strength %s) — Deals %s toxic smoke damage. The stronger the tobacco, the more dangerous the smoke.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.title: Kaif System
quasium.progression.kaif_system.hint: Smoking gives something called 'kaif'... What is it and how does it work?
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page1: Kaif — resource from -100 to +100. Accumulated while smoking: 2 kaif/sec × puff efficiency. Incompatible tobaccos subtract kaif and cause nausea. The kaifometer (iron + redstone) shows the current level.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page2: Kaif unlocks quasium ore access (kaif ≥ 10 = diamond pickaxe + Fortune). Higher kaif = more ore drops. Kaif ≥ 50 needed for backpack hookah craft on the anvil.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page3: Overdose: 50 g of tobacco within 10 minutes — kaif instantly halves and you get nausea, darkness and weakness. Be careful! Kaif naturally decays if you don't smoke. High kaif = bonuses, low = nothing.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.title: Kaif Mastery
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.hint: When kaif reaches great heights... The world reveals new secrets.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.page1: You've reached a high kaif level! Kaif grows from smoking and unlocks new possibilities. Higher kaif reveals more secrets: ore becomes generous, the anvil accepts new recipes.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.page2: At kaif ≥ 50 you can craft the backpack hookah on the quasium anvil (hookah + leather, 5 hammer hits). Kaif ≥ 10 — access to quasium ore. Kaif is the key to progression!
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.title: Quasium Ore
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.hint: Deep underground hides a special ore... But it reveals itself only in the right state.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page1: Deep underground lies quasium ore. It hides among deepslate and waits for someone who can unlock its potential. But not everyone can mine it...
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page2: The ore reveals itself only to those in the right state. You need a diamond pickaxe and sufficient kaif level (≥ 10) — otherwise the ore won't yield its treasures.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page3: Higher kaif = more generous ore: Fortune = min(3, (kaif-10)/30). Minimum — 1 piece, maximum — up to 4 per block. Silk Touch = take whole.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page4: There is a legend about silk touch... They say those who master this art can take the ore whole, without breaking it.
The ore revealed its secrets for the first time! Minimum kaif — 1 piece of raw quasium.
A new sensation... the ore becomes more generous! Up to 2 pieces per block.
Deep disposition opens new horizons! The ore can give up to 3 pieces.
Perfect state! Up to 4 pieces per block. Maximum luck!
quasium.progression.smelting_quasium.hin: Raw quasium... If smelted, it becomes something useful?
quasium.progression.smelting_quasium.pag: Raw quasium is found by mining quasium ore with sufficient kaif. Higher kaif = more drops. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace: raw quasium → ingot.
Quasium ingot — material for armor and anvil. 9 ingots → undried block → drying on shelf → quasium block. Block + iron → quasium anvil.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.title: Quasium Anvil
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.hint: Quasium can be shaped into an anvil... For special crafts.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page1: Quasium anvil: 3 dried quasium blocks + 4 iron ingots (like a regular anvil). 3 slots. Right-click with a netherite hammer to strike. The recipe completes after the required number of hits.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page2: Netherite hammer: 3 netherite ingots + 2 sticks. Loses durability while forging. Each hit = 1 progress step. Recipe: hookah + leather = backpack hookah (5 hits, kaif ≥ 50).
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page3: Backpack hookah requires kaif ≥ 50! Anvil shows 'Kaif %s required' if insufficient. Hit progress: 'Hit %s/%s' in GUI. When all hits done — crafting complete!
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.title: Quasium Armor
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.hint: Quasium is good for more than an anvil... Armor can be forged from it.
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.page1: Quasium armor: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots. Higher durability than iron, toughness 2.0, knockback resistance 0.1. The forging recipe hasn't been found yet — for now the armor only turns up for those who obtained it by other means.
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.page2: A full set of quasium armor = 80% dodge chance! On a dodge, 'Dodged!' appears above the hotbar and the damage is ignored entirely. A single piece without the full set gives no bonus.
quasium.progression.backpack_hookah.hint: Can a hookah be portable? Quasium anvil + high kaif...
quasium.progression.backpack_hookah.page: Backpack hookah — portable version. Craft on quasium anvil: hookah + leather (5 hammer hits, kaif ≥ 50). Fits in Curios back slot (back_hookah_slot).
Hotkeys instead of right-click: V = attach/detach pipe, B = open GUI. Pipe doesn't disconnect from distance (hookah is on your back!). Render: hookah model on back + black pipe to hand.

The mechanics are the same: charcoal in the calloud, tobacco in the bowl, essence and hookah upgrades. The same heat thresholds, overheat and puff efficiency apply. The difference is hotkeys, no distance check, and state stored in persistent data.
